# PhotonicNeuralAccelerator

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hardware accelerator that uses photonic components (e.g., Mach-Zehnder interferometers, micro-ring resonators) to execute neural network inference at the speed of light. Provides a high-throughput, energy-efficient compute substrate that can be embedded in network switches or routers, supporting in-network neuromorphic processing for TCC.
